# Block 1 at 0x644e0e
00644e0e  56               push    esi  ; (entry, a, b) -> BOOL. Half-open footprint containment on a type-2 subcomponent.

  baseA = entry[0x0C]  baseB = entry[0x10]
  spanA = entry[0x1C]  spanB = entry[0x20]
  return a <= baseA && b <= baseB && a > baseA - spanA && b > baseB - spanB;

So the anchor at +0x0C/+0x10 is the FAR corner and the span extends backwards: the covered
interval is (base - span, base] on each axis. This is why the ordering tests elsewhere take the
form (x - spanX - y + 1) <= 0 - that is the same half-open interval overlap written out.
